tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Full-text search (fuzzy, prefix) over Vercel OSS Program projects by name, topics and description, with optional filters. Returns compact hits; call get_project for full details. Omit query to browse by filters.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Full catalog record(s) for one or more project ids (owner/repo) returned by search_projects.

tools.name: list_facets
tools.description: Values (with project counts) for a filter: topic, language or cohort. Use to pick valid search_projects filters.
